name: neo4j-mcp
description: Canary Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Neo4j.

NEO4J_READ_ONLY.title: Readonly flag
NEO4J_READ_ONLY.description: Set to true to disable write tools

NEO4J_TELEMETRY.title: Telemetry
NEO4J_TELEMETRY.description: Set to false to disable telemetry (default true)

NEO4J_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log Level
NEO4J_LOG_LEVEL.description: Log level (e.g., debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency)

NEO4J_LOG_FORMAT.title: Log Format
NEO4J_LOG_FORMAT.description: Log output format: text or json (default text)

NEO4J_SCHEMA_SAMPLE_SIZE.title: Schema inference sample size
NEO4J_SCHEMA_SAMPLE_SIZE.description: Number of nodes to sample for schema inference

NEO4J_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER.title: Embedding provider
NEO4J_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER.description: GenAI embedding provider for set-vector-property's text field / check-embedding-dimensions: openai, azure-openai, vertexai, or bedrock-titan; leave unset to disable both

NEO4J_MCP_EMBEDDING_CONFIGURATION.title: Embedding provider configuration
NEO4J_MCP_EMBEDDING_CONFIGURATION.description: Comma-separated key=value settings for the embedding provider above (e.g. token=sk-xxx,model=text-embedding-3-small) — required keys vary by provider

tools.name: get-schema
tools.description: Introspect labels, relationship types, property keys

tools.name: read-cypher
tools.description: Execute arbitrary Cypher (read mode)

tools.name: write-cypher
tools.description: Execute arbitrary Cypher (write mode)

tools.name: explain-cypher
tools.description: Show the query plan for a Cypher statement without executing it

tools.name: profile-cypher
tools.description: Execute a Cypher statement and return results plus a profiled plan with runtime statistics

tools.name: list-constraints-and-indexes
tools.description: List the database's constraints and indexes

tools.name: create-constraint
tools.description: Create a uniqueness, key, or property-existence constraint

tools.name: drop-constraint
tools.description: Drop a constraint by name

tools.name: create-index
tools.description: Create a range, text, point, or lookup index

tools.name: drop-index
tools.description: Drop an index by name

tools.name: list-gds-procedures
tools.description: List GDS procedures available in the instance

tools.name: vector-search
tools.description: Run an approximate nearest-neighbor similarity search against a vector index

tools.name: fulltext-search
tools.description: Run a Lucene-backed full-text search against a fulltext index

tools.name: create-vector-index
tools.description: Create a vector index for similarity search

tools.name: create-fulltext-index
tools.description: Create a fulltext index for text search

tools.name: set-vector-property
tools.description: Set a node or relationship's embedding vector property

tools.name: check-embedding-dimensions
tools.description: Validate a configured embedding provider/model against a vector index's dimensions

tools.name: create-node
tools.description: Create a node with labels and properties

tools.name: find-nodes
tools.description: Find nodes by label, property values and/or filters

tools.name: get-node
tools.description: Get one node plus its relationship counts by type and direction

tools.name: update-node
tools.description: Set/remove properties and add/remove labels on existing nodes

tools.name: delete-node
tools.description: Delete nodes

tools.name: count-nodes
tools.description: Count nodes matching labels/properties/filters

tools.name: create-relationship
tools.description: Create a directed relationship between two existing nodes

tools.name: find-relationships
tools.description: Find relationships by type, end nodes and/or properties

tools.name: update-relationship
tools.description: Set/remove properties on existing relationships

tools.name: delete-relationship
tools.description: Delete relationships (end nodes are kept)

tools.name: traverse
tools.description: Walk outward from a node: reachable nodes with depth, or the paths

tools.name: expand-neighbors
tools.description: Everything exactly one hop from a node

tools.name: find-shortest-path
tools.description: Shortest route (or all tied shortest) between two nodes

tools.name: find-all-paths
tools.description: Enumerate routes between two nodes, shortest first

tools.name: match-pattern
tools.description: Find occurrences of a described pattern; return rows, a count, or existence

tools.name: find-common-connections
tools.description: Nodes shared by 2–5 given nodes (shared neighbors)

tools.name: find-motif
tools.description: Detect `star`, `fan-in`, `fan-out`, `triangle` or `cycle` shapes

tools.name: find-relationship-chain
tools.description: Follow an exact, ordered sequence of relationships from a node

tools.name: find-subgraph
tools.description: Extract the neighborhood around a node as nodes + relationships
